description: Core selected-place state and data-integrity fixes in src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx: remove Dawki as a visible default selection (separate initial CAMERA from selected DESTINATION, selectedPlace starts null), add HARD India country validation on reverse-geocode + geocoding + SearchDestinations location, fix the photo-fallback bug, audit the open/closed metadata, and replace the default red Google marker with a no-red brand marker. This is the headline behavioral pass. All the matrix tests that assert data/behavior (A, D, E, G, H, I, K, M, N, O) and the open-now audit live here. Keep every change inline in the component return (styled-jsx scope) and preserve honest degradation.
steps: SECTION 01 - remove Dawki default. Delete the DEFAULT_PLACE = Dawki constant (lines ~183-189) OR repurpose it into a neutral non-selected INITIAL_CAMERA constant (e.g. a central-India center like { lat: 22.9734, lng: 78.6569 } with a lower country-level zoom ~5) that is clearly NOT a selected place. Change the place state to selectable-null: `const [ place, setPlace ] = useState<PlaceState | null>( null )` (introduce the null case throughout). The map's new google.maps.Map center must use the neutral INITIAL_CAMERA center + country zoom, NOT a selected place. Do NOT construct the selected marker on load - create/show it only once `place` is non-null (see marker step). The recenter effect must no-op when place is null. The reverse-geocode/geocoding fallbacks that currently fall back to DEFAULT_PLACE.lat/lng (lines ~1446-1447) must instead drop the result when no real location is available (do not invent coordinates).

SECTION 01/20 - gate all place-dependent UI on a non-null selection. The left place card identity (name/address/metadata), the selected marker, the bottom destination bar, and the AQI/PM2.5 result must NOT render until `place` (or a map-click candidate) is a real selection. The AQI/PM2.5 pills may remain visible on the clean map, but clicking a pill with NO selected place must NOT start a spatial AQ-grid fetch (guard the layer-activation effect on a real selected location). Ensure ZERO environmental/AQ fetch is driven by the removed default or by the neutral camera. The non-map shell, search field, and clean India map still render.

SECTION 05 - hard India country validation. Add a helper e.g. `isIndiaResult(result): boolean` that inspects a geocoder result's address_components, finds the component whose `types` include 'country', and returns true only when its `short_name` (shortText) === 'IN'. Apply it in: (1) the map-click reverse-geocode callback (~line 758) - iterate rows, pick the FIRST row that passes isIndiaResult; if none pass, do NOT setPlace to a foreign location - keep the previous selection and optionally surface an honest 'That location is outside India' status; (2) the geocoding search fallback mapping (~line 1430) - filter to India results only. Keep the existing INDIA_BOUNDS map restriction and includedRegionCodes/region:'in' bias (bias is necessary but NOT sufficient - the explicit country check is the fix). For the SearchDestinations path, if it returns a resolved location, apply the same India check before using it (document that this branch is only live on *.wecare.digital).

SECTION 21 - photo-fallback fix. In the media-fallback effect (~line 866-915), replace the broken `exactCleanPhotos = (target.photos||[]).filter(photo => photo.attributions.length === 0)` gate. The correct rule: if the selected place has ANY valid exact photo (any entry in target.photos with a non-empty url, regardless of whether it carries attribution), USE the exact photos and do NOT fetch nearby photos - clear nearbyPhotos and return. Only run searchNearby when there is genuinely NO usable exact photo. Required Google Place Photo author attribution must still ride with whichever photos are displayed (keep the figcaption rendering). Do not worsen the existing react-hooks/set-state-in-effect eslint warning - prefer returning early without an extra setState where the state is already empty, or keep the single setState the lint already tolerates.

SECTION 22 - open/closed metadata audit. The modern Places JS API (new google.maps.places.Place) exposes opening status via regularOpeningHours; audit whether `regularOpeningHours.openNow` is a reliably-populated boolean on the field shape the component actually requests ('regularOpeningHours' in PLACE_META_FIELDS). If it is supported (it is on the Place class when the field is requested and the place has hours), keep the 'Open now'/'Closed now' line but ensure it only renders when the boolean is genuinely present (metaFromGooglePlace already guards `typeof openNow === 'boolean'` - keep that honest guard). If the audit shows the field is NOT reliably present on this API shape, OMIT the opening-status line rather than fabricate it. Record the decision (keep-with-guard vs remove) in the feature findings and in a decision note.

SECTION 13 - custom no-red selected marker. Replace the plain `new maps.Marker({ position, map, title })` (default red pin, ~lines 739-743 and the recenter effect) with a no-red brand marker. Decide between: (A) google.maps.marker.AdvancedMarkerElement with a custom DOM/pin content (requires importLibrary('marker') + a mapId; richer but heavier), or (B) a styled classic Marker using an SVG symbol / data-URI icon in the brand palette (dark-green #1a3a2a body, lime #d1f470 accent, white ring for contrast). Choose B unless A is clearly better, because B keeps working under the existing FakeMarker test stub and needs no mapId; justify the choice in a decision note. The marker must be visually distinct from the small AQ sample dots (a larger pin/ringed marker vs small filled circles). Create it only when a place is selected; update its position via the recenter effect. Keep it working under the stubbed-google tests (FakeMarker has setPosition/setTitle; if using a Symbol icon, pass it in the Marker opts the stub records).

TESTS (matrix, add to src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx, behavioral - drive real state/handlers): A - on initial load with a key, NO Dawki/selected place is presented (query the left card has no selected name, no 'Dawki' text anywhere), NO bottom destination bar is rendered, and NO AQ-grid fetch fires on load (airConditionsFetch recorder shows zero currentConditions calls). D - simulate a map click: assert geocoder.geocode is called with a {location} request and that a valid IN result updates the selection (destbar appears with the resolved name). E - foreign-country rejection: configure the FakeGeocoder to return a first result with country short_name 'BD' (Bangladesh) followed by a valid IN result; assert the BD result does NOT become the selected place and the valid IN fallback IS accepted (extend installGoogleMaps/InstallOpts to allow a scripted multi-row reverse-geocode result). H - no raster: assert FakeImageMapType is never constructed for a layer (rec.imageMapTypeOpts stays empty) and no fetch URL contains '/heatmapTiles/'. I - AQ dots: zero sample requests on load; an AQI pill click (after a place is selected) triggers currentConditions requests and attaches the deck.gl overlay (deckRec.overlaySetMapCalls non-empty); switching the layer off clears the overlay (setProps layers:[] and/or setMap(null)); a destination change aborts stale requests; a cache hit avoids immediate repeat network calls. K - marker: assert the selected marker uses brand styling and NOT a default red marker (e.g. the Marker opts the stub records carry a no-red icon/symbol, or an AdvancedMarkerElement with brand content is created); keep this test tolerant if the chosen API is not observable through the stub, but assert what IS observable. N - PM2.5 result is driven by real concentration (the dot fill for a PM2.5 layer comes from pm25Severity(real pm25), not aqiCategory(aqi)); assert a PM2.5 scatter layer's getFillColor for a dot with a known pm25 maps to the pm25Severity band, and the left PM2.5 result prints the real ug/m3 value. O - keep the existing no-key honest-degradation test green (zero network, no map, no destbar, no marker, non-map shell renders). Also KEEP green: the geocoding-import test (C) and the Place-photo attribution guard test and the existing destbar/degradation tests.

Run npm run typecheck, npm run lint (0 errors), and npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx; fix any regressions. Confirm the honest-degradation, geocoding-import, and attribution tests still pass.
acceptance_criteria: No 'Dawki' string and no DEFAULT_PLACE-as-selection remains; `place` initializes null and the initial map camera is a neutral India view, not a selected place
With a key, initial load shows a clean India map: no selected-place card identity, no marker, no destination bar, and zero AQ/environmental fetches (matrix A)

A map click reverse-geocode only accepts a result whose country short_name is 'IN'; a Bangladesh (BD) first result is rejected and a valid IN fallback is used, otherwise the previous selection is kept (matrix D, E)
The selected place marker uses a no-red brand style (dark-green/lime/white) distinct from the AQ sample dots, with no default red Google pin (matrix K)

An exact selected-place photo with attribution is used directly (attribution shown) and does NOT trigger a nearby-photo fetch; nearby fallback runs only when there is no usable exact photo (section 21)
The open/closed line is either backed by a supported Places field with an honest boolean guard or omitted; the decision is recorded
PM2.5 dots and the left PM2.5 result are driven by real PM2.5 concentration, not AQI-derived severity (matrix N)
No ImageMapType / raster heatmap path for AQI/PM2.5; AQ dots fetch only on pill click and only when a place is selected (matrix H, I)
No-key honest degradation unchanged (matrix O); geocoding-import and attribution tests stay green
findings: Removed the Dawki DEFAULT_PLACE and replaced it with a neutral INITIAL_CAMERA (central-India centre 22.9734,78.6569 at country zoom 5). `place` state now inits null; the map opens with no selected-place card, no marker, no destination bar and no environmental fetch until a real search-select or validated map click. Gated the layer-activation effect, loadSolar, the recenter effect, the destination-resolve effect and the whole left place-card render on a non-null selection. Added hard India country gate isIndiaResult() (reads short_name/shortText of the 'country' address component, accepts only 'IN'); applied to the map-click reverse-geocode (iterate rows, first IN wins, else keep previous selection + honest 'outside India' status, never invent coordinates), the geocoding search fallback (India-only + require a real geometry location, dropped the DEFAULT_PLACE.lat/lng fallback), and softly to the autocomplete toPlace() path (added addressComponents to the requested fields; reject only when a country component is present and non-IN - documented as live only on *.wecare.digital). Fixed the photo-fallback: ANY exact photo with a non-empty url is used (its attribution rides in the figcaption) and searchNearby runs only when there is NO usable exact photo; dropped the broken attributions.length===0 gate without worsening the set-state-in-effect lint profile. MARKER API CHOICE: B - a styled classic google.maps.Marker with an inline SVG data-URI icon (dark-green #1a3a2a body, lime #d1f470 dot, white ring, 36x48, no red), created lazily on first selection; chosen over AdvancedMarkerElement because it works under the FakeMarker stub and needs no mapId. OPEN/CLOSED AUDIT: OMITTED. On the modern google.maps.places.Place, open-now status is the async Place.isOpen() method, not a reliable static regularOpeningHours.openNow boolean, so the field is no longer requested and the open/closed line was removed (PLACE_META_FIELDS, PlaceState, GooglePlaceLike, metaFromGooglePlace, render all updated). Extended the test harness: FakeMap records the map-'click' handler, FakeMarker records its opts, added Size/Point ctors and a scripted reverseRows InstallOpt (multi-row reverse-geocode) plus an India address_components row by default. Updated the existing tests that assumed a Dawki default to select Mumbai first (added a selectMumbai() helper), and added matrix tests A, A2, D, E, E2, K, N. GATES: npm run typecheck clean; npx eslint . = 0 errors / 203 warnings (baseline, no new warnings; VayuLokLive stays at 8 warnings, 3 set-state-in-effect); npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx = 41 passed; full suite 942 passed / 3 skipped / 0 failed. Wrote decisions.md. Did not rebuild the already-correct deck.gl dots / destbar / autocomplete / attribution; left the pill/token/card-composition work to FEAT-003.
